mentions.name: FormBeep
mentions.description: A small tool that sends a notification to your phone when someone submits a form on your website. It is a single lightweight script that works seamlessly across platforms.
mentions.problem: Website owners need a timely alert when someone submits a form on their site; it started as a client problem the author also personally experienced.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a small tool called FormBeep[1] that sends a notification to your phone when someone submits a form on your website.

It started as a client problem, then something which I also experienced so decided to built it. It's just one small script and work seamlessly across platforms.
